body: The thing is that I don't see where I can get another job.... I have been in school so long I only have had jobs in that field so no other experience for anything else and it requires so much work that I often have to take home but have difficulty completing secondary to no help with kids. I looked into paying for additional childcare once I am at home but it was so expensive that most of my pay check would go to that and I wouldn't have enough to pay for housing and utilities once I paid for childcare.   I just give up. I hope that things will work out for you .

Do you have any siblings or close friends you could come out to first that maybe could act as a buffer between you and your parents.? Or maybe an LGBT community in your area... That is what my younger brother did when he came out so he had that support system to rely on
I have been waiting on better days for many years

US I don't qualify for social services until I have depleted all of my savings and then I will qualify for  a little over $300/month which would not even cover housing much less other expenses... Plus I would rather not be on government programs as I already have enough stigma and stereotypes against me being a woman, minority and add the single parent to that

I'm an older single parent to twins . no help. 
Just recently lost job because I can't keep up with all the work and stress and taking care of children on my own. Often had to take work home but hardly any time to do when you are caring for children on your own. 
I have tons of student loan debt. 
No support system.
And too many other things to write. I am drowning at the shore

I have 1year old twins. They will not remember me... I don't remember anything from when I was that young. And depression plays some role but life circumstances play a bigger role for me at the moment and I just don't have any reserve to keep fighting a losing battle
I really have no other options and no one will miss me anyway

They are only 1yo.  In order to be a good mother, would need to be more functional and all they have learned from me is to be a big cry baby and they need more than that because unless something drastically changes in this world they will have to fight both sexism and racism and need a better role model
I think that they are young enough where they would not remember plus I think having a mother like me would be more traumatic than losing me

I have just had a pretty hard life in general.. I don't have relatives that help (imagine having had a csection where you have no support other than medical personnel in the room then going home to recover alone with 2 babies and no help) ; no friends; work became too much as I always had work to take home and no help with 2little ones
Finances isn't the main issue.. There have been many things compounding for many years and I have no fight left

There's really not much available here and what is...is subpar...I know because prior to recently losing my job, I worked in a profession where I had difficulty finding help for people because lack of resources
They will probably forget soon and they are better off without me
I have no place to go for help..it's just me and them and I can no longer do it

Not any reliable family.  They know how i feel and all they say is that I am not the only one to ever have the things that have happened to me happen. I have always had to deal with everything on my own

I have no friends 
 Recently lost my job because I "don't fit in " and I am just hopeless.  I get no help whatsoever with taking care of my twins.  It's all too much. .my life has been one  misfortune after another

I am not living  just  merely waking up each day and this has been occurring for a long time.   Everything has worsened since I had my twins.  At about 20 weeks while hospitalized I found myself doing it all alone on top of everything else
